source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
On timelines, we are aiming to move as quickly as possible, can we aim to have this ready by FRIDAY lates.? so please proceed with the model build using available information. We can refine as additional inputs are confirmed.

In terms of data availability:

1)Please see the attached feasibility/demand analysis (FleetPod-Demand-Analysis) so you may use it directionally alongside the assumptions in the brief.

2)Capex figures are not yet finalized. The overall program is currently estimated in the
150–180M range, and you may proceed using the midpoint of the ranges provided in the brief. You can see the attached business case for the mid point set

3) We do not yet have firm numbers on land values, lease costs, opex, or pricing. Please proceed using the indicative ranges in the document and flag assumptions clearly.

4) Financing terms are not confirmed at this stage—no lenders or investor commitments yet. Please apply standard market assumptions based on the ranges provided.

5) Site-level data (traffic counts, land status, etc.) is not yet available in a structured format. We only a genberal traffic count per corridor but site level details are not available so it has to be modelled.

6) Please proceed in CAD using a 2026 base year.
7) A key requirement is to clearly demonstrate and justify the need for availability-style payments to ensure the project is viable and bankable. THIS IS THE CORE INFORMATION THE GOVERNMENT WANTS TO SEE so i need this to be modelled correctlty

In short, please proceed using the brief and attached materials as the primary reference points and clearly annotate all assumptions—we will iterate as more definitive inputs become available.

Let me know if anything critical arises during the build.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Sure that's fine, we can end the contract here.

To be clear on the record the first draft was delivered on time and covered everything in the original brief. When you gave feedback that it was hard to follow, I did not ignore it I delivered a second, substantially revised version addressing that feedback directly. A simplified dashboard, clearly sourced assumptions, separated cash flows for both funding scenarios, additional financial statements, and a short summary presentation for easier review. That second deliverable was sent before you requested this refund, and I did not receive any specific review comments on it, or on the first draft, despite asking.

Given that both milestones were completed and delivered as scoped, I won't be issuing a refund. I'll be raising this through Upwork's dispute process to resolve the remaining milestone payment. You're welcome to leave whatever review you feel is accurate I'll do the same, and I'll let the delivered work and message history speak for themselves.

Happy to end this professionally on both sides.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the revised model included additional financial statements and separated cash flows for both funding scenarios.

routing_warnings.description: The reported complexity and difficulty reviewing the model concern understandability and auditability rather than the presence or operation of integrated financial statements.
The client's broad report of many errors and poor quality is better evaluated under data and formula integrity; it does not specifically identify a failure of the financial statements.
